Record Class BenchmarkRunResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
uno.anahata.asi.yam.tools.benchmarks.BenchmarkRunResult
Record Components:
participant - The candidate model participant configuration.
testCode - The unique code of the benchmark test (e.g., "JAVA-JNA-1").
asiContainer - The identifier of the ASI container where the test was executed (e.g. "NetBeansAsiContainer", "AsiDesktopAsiContainer").
timestamp - The exact time the benchmark run was executed.
durationSeconds - The wall-clock execution duration in seconds.
turns - The total number of conversational turns taken by the model.
promptTokens - The total input (prompt) tokens consumed across all turns.
candidatesTokens - The total output (candidate) tokens generated across all turns.
thoughtsTokens - The total internal reasoning (thinking) tokens generated across all turns.
totalTokens - The total interaction tokens reported by the provider.
passed - Whether the benchmark test completed successfully with zero defects.
judgeScores - A map of judge names to their given ratings (e.g. "Pablo" -> 9.0, "Vijay" -> 8.5).
videoUrl - The URL to the run demonstration video (e.g. YouTube video).
screenshotPath - The relative or absolute path to the captured execution screenshot.
sessionId - The unique UUID of the child AGI session that executed the test.
observations - Optional notes, tool outputs, or qualitative developer feedback.
public record BenchmarkRunResult(BenchmarkParticipant participant, String testCode, String asiContainer, Instant timestamp, double durationSeconds, int turns, int promptTokens, int candidatesTokens, int thoughtsTokens, int totalTokens, boolean passed, Map<String,Double> judgeScores, String videoUrl, String screenshotPath, String sessionId, String observations) extends Record
Immutable telemetry record capturing the complete execution metrics and outcome of a benchmark test run.

Binds the candidate BenchmarkParticipant, test code, duration, turn count, fine-grained token economics (prompt, candidate, thoughts, and total), execution pass/fail status, media assets (video URL, screenshot), container identifier, and multi-judge subjective scores.

anahata
